metadata.domain: AI Vision Perception / ADAS / Computer Vision

evidence.trl_pathway: Chiplet-Based AI Accelerators (TRL 3) is scheduled to complete in just 1 quarter (2027-Q1 to 2027-Q2), which is wholly unrealistic for a TRL 3 technology; similarly, HBM Integration (TRL 4) and Event-Based Vision Processing (TRL 4) face aggressive timelines, and two confirmed dependency violations mean prerequisite technologies aren't even complete when dependent projects begin.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared 기술선도 strategy calls for exploratory, lower-TRL R&D-heavy investments, and while Neuromorphic Computing (TRL 2) and Event-Based Vision Processing (TRL 4) fit that profile, high-Tier investment in TRL 7 Functional Safety Certification and TRL 6 AI Model Compression reflects near-market commercialization logic that contradicts a pure technology leadership posture.
evidence.competitive_awareness: HBM Integration and Advanced Packaging for AI are semiconductor manufacturing/packaging technologies far outside the stated domain of AI Vision Perception/ADAS/Computer Vision, where the company has no established competitive advantage against memory and packaging specialists like SK Hynix or TSMC; domain drift across 3 of 7 selections significantly undermines competitive positioning.
evidence.market_timing: For a 기술선도 strategy, technologies should complete 1-2 years before market boom to preempt competitors; most completions are timed exactly at boom (0.0yr error), which is market profit maximization behavior, not technology leadership preemption, and Event-Based Vision and Neuromorphic Computing complete 0.75 years after their respective booms.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: Some selections like Event-Based Vision Processing and Neuromorphic Computing do sit in convergence zones of emerging patents and growing markets, but HBM and Advanced Packaging selections appear driven primarily by market signals rather than deliberate patent-market convergence analysis aligned to the company's core vision perception domain.

strengths: Budget is fully utilized with zero violation, demonstrating disciplined financial planning
Neuromorphic Computing and Event-Based Vision Processing genuinely represent technology leadership bets with low TRL and long development horizons appropriate for 기술선도
weaknesses: Two hard dependency violations render the Chiplet and HBM sub-roadmaps structurally infeasible as scheduled
Significant domain drift into semiconductor packaging and memory technologies (S01, S02, S03) where the company has no competitive home-court advantage
missing_technologies: 3D point cloud / LiDAR deep learning perception algorithms (core ADAS vision domain)
Transformer-based vision foundation models for autonomous driving (patent-market convergence zone)
Radar-camera sensor fusion architectures (on-domain, emerging patent activity)
investment_issues: All 7 technologies are assigned identical High Tier with identical scores (4.0/5.0/4.0/3.0/4.0), which signals a lack of genuine prioritization and portfolio differentiation
High investment in Functional Safety Certification (TRL 7, Process category) is misaligned with 기술선도 — this is an operational compliance activity, not a technology leadership investment
timing_issues: Chiplet-Based AI Accelerators (TRL 3) completing in 1 quarter is physically impossible — minimum realistic timeline would be 2-3 years
Event-Based Vision Processing and Neuromorphic Computing complete 0.75 years after their market boom windows, missing the preemption window expected for 기술선도
HBM Integration depends on S03 (Advanced Packaging) which ends 2028-Q3, but HBM starts 2027-Q3 — a full year of dependency violation
